profile.Name: Glurgh
profile.Job: Fishman living in Stone Rat Village
profile.Personality: Excitable and hard to understand. He grows more insistent when no one understands him, sighs when ignored, and turns agitated on Fishman Island.
profile.Backstory: A Fishman living among the Swampers of Stone Rat Village. Asked whether he wants a way out of town, he answers with an eager gurgle.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Speaks no words; every line is a gurgling "Glurgh!", louder and more repeated as he gets worked up.
